Container.Name: tidbyt-monarch
Container.Overview: Show Monarch Money on your Tidbyt: one 2x2 grid with net worth, budget used, savings rate and cashflow, or a rotation of full-screen views. Renders locally and pushes the pixels to Tidbyt cloud or a self-hosted Tronbyt server.
Container.Description: Show Monarch Money on your Tidbyt: one 2x2 grid with net worth, budget used, savings rate and cashflow, or a rotation of full-screen views. Renders locally and pushes the pixels to Tidbyt cloud or a self-hosted Tronbyt server. Requires a Monarch email and password. Set MONARCH_MFA_SECRET (the TOTP seed) if MFA is enabled so re-login works unattended.

Config.Name: Monarch Email
Config.Description: Your Monarch login email

Config.Name: Monarch Password
Config.Description: Your Monarch password. Set one under Settings > Security if you sign in with Google

Config.Name: Monarch MFA Secret
Config.Description: TOTP seed from Monarch Settings > Security > Enable MFA (two-factor text code or otpauth:// URI). Needed for unattended re-login

Config.Name: Tidbyt Device ID
Config.Description: Tidbyt cloud device id, or the device id in Tronbyt

Config.Name: Tidbyt API Key
Config.Description: Tidbyt API key, or the per-device key from the Tronbyt UI

Config.Name: Push API Base
Config.Description: Leave default for Tidbyt cloud, or http://server:port/v0 for Tronbyt

Config.Name: Views
Config.Description: dashboard for the 2x2 grid, or a rotation: networth,budget,goal,cashflow,bill

Config.Name: Update Interval
Config.Description: Seconds each view stays on screen (minimum 10)

Config.Name: Cache TTL
Config.Description: Seconds to reuse fetched Monarch data before calling the API again (0 disables the cache)

Config.Name: Budget Category
Config.Description: Optional: budget category to track instead of the month's totals (case-insensitive)

Config.Name: Goal ID
Config.Description: Optional: show a specific savings goal instead of the first active one

Config.Name: Gotify URL
Config.Description: Optional: Gotify base URL for failure alerts, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8070 (an address the container can resolve)

Config.Name: Gotify Token
Config.Description: Optional: Gotify app token for failure alerts

Config.Name: Alert After Failures
Config.Description: Consecutive failed cycles before alerting

Config.Name: Alert Repeat Every
Config.Description: Repeat the alert every N failures while still broken (0 disables repeats)

Config.Name: Debug Values
Config.Description: Set to 1 to print figures to the container log (off by default)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as, matching appdata ownership

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for logs and today's date

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Where the Monarch session file lives inside the container
